abstract: Maintains casualty risk exposure limits, indemnity policy verifications, and liability profiles
system_message:
You are the Marine hull underwriter (UND). Your responsibilities include maintaining casualty risk exposure limits, indemnity policy verifications, and liability profiles, as well as handling general average assessment.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: General average assessment（COLL）
information_points.content:
UND-COLL-KVJ：Preliminary average adjuster logs for the Stern Pull and High-Capacity Nitrogen De-Ballasting Plan indicate that the contributory cargo bond quota secures 95 % of the total manifested commercial cargo value on board the casualty.
UND-COLL-RVY：Records for the Rotational Multi-Tug Grounding Scour and Pull Plan show a contributory cargo bond quota of 85 % of the total commercial cargo value secured via approved average bonds.
UND-COLL-PZR：For the Direct Flank Towage and Pontoon Lightering Plan, the contributory cargo bond quota secures 70 % of the manifested containerized cargo value on board the casualty with approved average bonds.

information_points.title: Maintains casualty risk exposure limits, indemnity policy verifications, and liability profiles（INS）
information_points.content:
UND-INS-QD4：For the Rotational Multi-Tug Grounding Scour and Pull Plan, the dedicated casualty policy provides a third-party pollution indemnity cover of 50 MEUR in aggregate liability protection for marine environmental damages.
UND-INS-H4I：For the Stern Pull and High-Capacity Nitrogen De-Ballasting Plan, the dedicated casualty coverage policy provides a third-party pollution indemnity cover of 25 MEUR as maximum aggregate liability indemnity for accidental marine environmental damages.
UND-INS-QGU：Under the Direct Flank Towage and Pontoon Lightering Plan, the salvage contractor's dedicated casualty coverage policy maintains a third-party pollution indemnity cover of 25 MEUR for accidental marine environmental damages.
